NODE_ENV.description: Runtime mode. Keep production (the image ships the production build).

PORT.description: HTTP listen port. The bundled React dashboard, the REST API (under /api), and Swagger (when enabled) all serve from this one port.

TZ.description: Timezone for log stamps and 'today' stats. Stored message timestamps are always UTC.

DATABASE_TYPE.description: Data store: 'sqlite' (zero-config, lives on the openwa-data volume at /app/data) or 'postgres' (then also set DATABASE_HOST/PORT/USERNAME/PASSWORD, typically a sibling Postgres service).

API_KEY_PEPPER.description: Optional HMAC pepper for API-key hashing. Leave blank to use plain SHA-256. If you set it, set it BEFORE first boot — enabling it later locks out existing keys until the old pepper is restored.

BASE_URL.description: Public URL of this instance (e.g. https://openwa-xyz.up.railway.app). Used in outbound payloads and callback examples. Blank = app default.

ENABLE_SWAGGER.description: Set to 'true' to publish interactive API docs at /api/docs (off by default; recommended to leave off on a public domain).

AUTO_START_SESSIONS.description: Set to 'true' to reconnect previously paired WhatsApp sessions automatically on boot instead of showing a fresh QR code.
